ObstructBasicSight.Name: Basic Sight blocked by walls/regions/elevation
ObstructBasicSight.Hint: Off by default. When on, Basic Sight (not Feel Tremor) is blocked by walls, tall Regions, and looking up past your own eye level. This logic has broken live play more than once — turn it off here immediately if it acts up, no reload needed.

PreciseElevationLOS.Name: Precise parapet geometry when looking up
PreciseElevationLOS.Hint: On by default (requires 'Basic Sight blocked by...' above to also be on). Looking UP (target above the observer's own eye level) is tested with real 3D ray-vs-parapet trigonometry — the same math the attack/cover gate (blind-spot.mjs) already trusts — instead of the old flat 'above my eyes = never visible' rule. Turn off to restore the old flat rule if the new geometry acts up.

Consumable.StockDecrementHint: Shrink stock by one die — restocked or patched up

Item.DropGrantedItem: Drop an ability or other item from a compendium
Item.DropStartingItem: Drop equipment or a trophy from a compendium
Item.StatusEffectHint: Status effects associated with this card (up to {max})

Ability.RecoveryHint: "Recover action": the ability returns once the Recover action has been used the given number of times. "Once per period": it triggers once per the chosen period. "No condition": no recovery is needed.

Weapon.Direct3DHint: This weapon's Direct template accounts for the target's height: reach and footprint are recomputed for the elevation difference (Euclidean, √(range²−Δheight²)), and hits resolve against 3D creature volumes by size. Ranged → a diagonal projectile line to the endpoint's height; melee → the height difference eats into reach. Off = the old flat-plane behavior.
Weapon.HitLogicHint: Hit-resolution logic for THIS specific template. "Base" — flat footprint (plain cell-membership hit) plus a height tier by band (Ground/Low Flight/High Flight, see the "Can hit low/high flight" flags above) — the only option so far; reserved for future alternate per-template logic.
Weapon.AttackTypeHint: Which base action this weapon's attack logs as in the Planner — independent of whether its template is Direct or Vertical.
Weapon.CanHitLowFlightHint: Ranged only: without this flag, the attack can't touch a target in the "Low Flight" height band at all — even aimed dead-on. Off by default; enable for weapons/abilities that can plausibly reach a target flying not too high above the ground.
Weapon.CanHitHighFlightHint: Ranged only: without this flag, the attack can't touch a target in the "High Flight" height band at all — even aimed dead-on. Off by default; enable for long-range/specialized anti-air weapons.

DamageNature.Hint: Damage nature — physical or metaphysical. Combined with Attack Type (melee/ranged) it gives the full damage split.

Templates.Title: Templates
Templates.GMOnly: Only the GM can clear templates.

Survey.KeybindingHint: Toggles the tactical survey: object highlight, region heights and unit sizes in metres.

GridOverlay.ImportGridmapHint: Loads a map from GOD Tactical Mapper: image, grid size, and sector settings are applied automatically.

RegionLightWalls.FieldHint: Builds real walls along this Region's outline that block ONLY light (not sight or movement) — so light sources stop shining straight through it. Walls are automatically rebuilt when the Region's shape changes, and removed when this is unchecked or the Region is deleted.
RegionLightWalls.InsetHint: How far the generated walls sit inward from the Region's boundary instead of exactly on it. 0 = right on the outline.
RegionLightWalls.ElevationHint: Copies the Region's Bottom/Top into the wall's Wall Height module range, so the wall only blocks light within that elevation band instead of at every height. On by default.

SceneDarkness.FieldHint: How opaque the out-of-sight black areas are (behind walls/fences but within range). 100% is Foundry's normal solid black; lower it to see the map through the shadow. Purely visual — doesn't affect sight range, cover, or combat math.
SceneDarkness.FloorHint: A separate setting: raises the minimum brightness of the WHOLE scene without touching already-lit areas — a night-vision assist for the GM. Unlike Darkness Opacity above, this also works where it's genuinely dark (real light blocked by a wall, low Darkness Level, etc), not just fog-of-war outside your sight range. 0% = off (normal).

CharBuilder.Title: Character Builder
CharBuilder.ClassCompetenciesHint: Pick competencies off the selected class's own list.
CharBuilder.NoClassCompetencies: The selected class has no competencies of its own — move on to the next step.
CharBuilder.CompetenciesHint: Pick exactly 2 competencies off the general list — unrestricted by class.
CharBuilder.CompetencyTakenHint: Already picked on the other competency step.
CharBuilder.ItemsHint: The class's starting kit is granted for free. First select a trophy from your kit (click its card), then click an item in the equipment list below. An offer can be spent across SEVERAL items as long as its rarity covers them — a rarity-3 trophy can buy one rarity-3 item, or a rarity-2 item plus a rarity-1 item, or three rarity-1 items, or just one item of lower rarity (the rest is forfeited). You can also select SEVERAL trophies of the same rarity — they combine into one offer worth one rarity rank higher per extra trophy (e.g. two rarity-3 trophies together offer at rarity 4). Only items of rarity 4 or below from the Equipment compendium are shown.
